Results.ReviewText: If I had known what I know now when I purchased this grill, I would not have purchased it. I would have purchased another one like my previous grill. With my Tru-Infrared grill, you just placed the propane tank into its circular home in the base of the grill. It's very easy. With this Weber grill, you have to struggle in tight quarters with a heavy propane tank to get the tank onto a hook where the propane level gauge is located. The grease tray attached to the left side of the grill is in the way too. It's too easy to bump your hand against it while struggling to put the propane tank onto the hook. Weber also has a half-panel on the back side of the grill which limits access to putting the propane tank onto the hook from that side. There is no such limiting panel on the back side of my previous grill. I consider the propane level gauge to be rather useless anyway. From what I have read, the accuracy of the gauge is somewhat suspect. I prefer to empty the propane tank, and when it runs out, just switch it out for a second propane tank that I always have on hand. This grill also does not cook the hamburgers as well as my previous grill. I wouldn't have purchased this Weber grill if I had known about all of its shortcomings. Don’t make the same mistake I did.
Results.Title: Very Disappointed in the Spirit E-210 Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText: I originally submitted a review that was very critical of my new Weber Spirit E-210 grill.  Prior to this purchase, I had used Weber Q's for 20+ years, upgrading every time I purchased a new one.  When I made this purchase, I was also looking at the Weber Q - 2 burner grill, but decided that I would instead go with the Spirit.  The Weber Q is pretty straightforward to use.  The burners are closer to the grates and I could get a sear and stick to the recommended cooking times.  This grill is a little more intricate, has more parts and requires a little more self-education to figure out how to get a good product.  I am getting there - in part thanks to Weber's excellent customer service.  Following my negative review, a representative reached out to me and has continued to answer questions and be in touch.  With this person's help, my grilling experience has greatly improved.  I give four stars because I am still learning how to use the grill.  But, I definitely give Weber five stars for reaching out to me and actually showing concern about my experience.  And, I expect I'll think this grill was a five star purchase when "The Griller" figures everything out.
Results.Title: Update to previous review

Results.ReviewText:
I thought buying a Weber grill would mean quality and longevity compared to other grillls I have purchased. But that was not the case. 
The grills functions OK but the paintwork on the cabinet is very poor and started delaminating which led to severe rust within 3 years. I have had other grills that the sheet metal and paintwork lasted FAR longer. Really disappointed in Weber quality.

Results.ReviewText: Good size, but heats inconsistently.  The way the gas tubes/ports are positioned are not aligned to the grill. To get consistent heat you have to place the meat directly over the gas tubes/ports and there is a gap between the grid sections. It didn't seem to be designed well to maximize it's grilling efficiency.

Results.ReviewText: I’ve used this grill for about one month. The two burner grill heats quickly, igniter works great, side shelves are easy to put up and down, grill has a small footprint on my patio. I don’t know why Weber put a door on the front-I turn on the gas from the back. My last grill was not a Weber but the igniter & doors were the first things to fail.

Results.ReviewText: Great gas grill, My wife loves cooking on it as well as I. We are a household of two and this works great for us.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: This is a good grill.  But a few simple things would make it better.  The spacing of the grates is a little too big which makes it difficult to cook and keep small things from falling in the gaps.  Also, try coming up with a creative way to store some basic cooking tools.  Lastly, I really would have liked the 3-burner grill, but the selling point on this was the fold-down trays.  If the 300 series had that, I would have picked it.  Aside from these short comings, I do like it and it is a nice compact improvement to my deck.
Results.Title: So compact and so close to being a great grill

Results.ReviewText: The tank is not very convenient to get in to place. Other than that, the grill is 5 star.

Results.ReviewText: I have owned Weber Grills for 20 years and wouldn't have any other brand. They are designed for great grilling experiences whether steaks, chicken, rotisserie, shish kabob, corn or whatever. The grease slows away fro the food and into the pan for easy disposal. Cleanup is simple and the durability factor can't be beat. You can't go wrong with a Weber....well worth the money!

Results.ReviewText: Quality at affordable prices. My family has owned Weber Grills for years. I generally leave my other grills w/covers at my old house. We moved into our new home and I purchased the Kettle and E-210. I've enjoyed the way they cook, ALWAYS, cooked to perfection, never burnt, underdone like others who you can't adjust the flame just right. These grills are solid and sturdy. I recommend purchasing a good cover to protect your grills as this alone will make them last for years of good cooking.
Results.Title: Affordable, Dependable, Reliable

46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
